Finding submitted.

**Result: missing (insert at Section 10.3), preferred level, confidence 0.88**

- **Investigation:** Section 10 (effect of expiry/termination) covers only access wind-down, Deliverable delivery and refunds; Section 16.5 returns/destroys Confidential Information but expressly defers Customer Data to Sections 11 and 15; Section 11 has no operative text and Section 15 addresses processing limits and privacy only. Searches for "transition assistance", "Customer Data return export deletion", and "machine-readable format export" returned no exit-services, export-format, or deletion-timing obligation anywhere.
- **Redline:** one insert after 10.2 carrying all six preferred elements — six months' assistance at then-current rates on any expiry or termination, return of Customer Data in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days, and certified deletion *after* that return, with the fallback (90 days / 30-day export) offered in the comment.
